options.name: body
options.description: The body of the http request/response to the web service. If O(body_format) is set to V(json) it will take an already formatted JSON string or convert a data structure into JSON.

options.name: body_format
options.description: The serialization format of the body. When set to V(json), encodes the body argument, if needed, and automatically sets the Content-Type header accordingly.

options.name: headers
options.description: Add custom HTTP headers to a request in the format of a YAML hash.

options.name: method
options.description: The HTTP method of the request or response.

options.name: password
options.description: A password for the module to use for NTLM authentication.

options.name: return_content
options.description: Whether or not to return the body of the response as a "content" key in the dictionary result no matter it succeeded or failed.

options.name: status_code
options.description: A list of valid, numeric, HTTP status codes that signifies success of the request.

options.name: url
options.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL in the form (http|https)://host.domain[:port]/path

options.name: user
options.description: A username for the module to use for NTLM authentication.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to V(false) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
